limitations: The audit parses tracked and untracked non-test .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs/.sql files; it does not parse Swift/Rust/Python/shell, external dependencies, ignored generated output or inline HTML JavaScript.

Recognizable source SQL literals, templates and concatenations are checked. SQL synthesized without recognizable mutation syntax, reflective helper aliases and arbitrary new filesystem replacement calls are not a complete static dataflow proof.
Known whole-database functions and bounded generic selector modules are exact-hash pinned; classification does not place them inside the runtime admission transaction.
An authorized source reviewer must inspect changed sites before updating this contract. There is intentionally no bless/update command.
SQL-bearing diagnostic literals and fixture parser markers are exact-site classified, never ignored using blanket source patterns.
Caller-created raw DB handles, trusted callbacks, malicious privileged schema owners, hostile host execution and external GitHub/provider effects are not confined by this guard.
